decisions: Minutes of the October 5, 2025 board meeting approved as amended with unanimous consent.
Approved activation of an interim revolving credit facility of up to $500,000 with First Continental Bank to cover Q4 cash flow gap; Pierre Dubois authorized to finalize terms by November 15, 2025.
Approved granting Acme Corp a 30-day contract extension through January 31, 2026, maintaining current pricing and service levels.
Authorized Aiyana Park and Pierre Dubois to negotiate an expanded contract with Acme Corp targeting no less than $1.75 million annually, with a signature deadline of January 20, 2026.

Approved Phase 2 Operational Efficiency Initiative and procurement of the Streamline Dynamics platform; Aiyana Park designated as project lead with a go-live target of March 1, 2026, and a change management plan due December 1, 2025.

Authorized engagement of Talentbridge Executive Search to fill the Director of Business Development role with a placement fee cap of $35,000; Senior Data Strategist to be filled via internal processes; both roles to be filled by February 28, 2026.
Approved 2026 Strategic Planning Offsite for January 15–16, 2026; Pierre Dubois to distribute financial outlook pre-read by January 5, 2026.
